text.p: PHP Healthcare Corp said on Monday Charles Robbins would retire as company chairman and chief executive officer, and its board elected Jack Mazur president and CEO and Charles Reilly chairman.

Mazur has been an officer and director of the company since its inception and has served as president since 1995, PHP said. Reilly, a managing partner for Shamrock Investments, has been an adviser and a director of PHP for the past six years, it said.

Robbins, who founded PHP in 1975, would continue to serve as a special adviser to the president and board, the company said. Robbins also said he had no present plans to divest himself of his holdings in the company.
